info.title: Replacement Intervals
info.subtitle: Starting points — your wax matters more than the calendar

rows.title: Wax guards: monthly
rows.desc: Sooner if one aid goes quiet with good power

rows.title: Domes: 2-3 months
rows.desc: Replace when stiff, yellowed, split or whistling

rows.title: BTE tubing: 4-6 months
rows.desc: It hardens and cracks, thinning the sound

rows.title: Receivers: as needed
rows.desc: A clinic job — thin or distorted sound is the sign

rows.title: Dry them overnight
rows.desc: Moisture is what shortens receiver life

rows.title: Clean and check yearly
rows.desc: Vents, sound bore and contacts you cannot reach
